detach.title: Detach agent binding?
detach.message: Detach the agent from “{{title}}”? The agent keeps running, but events stop routing to this conversation until you rebind it.

rebind.title: Rebind detached agent?
rebind.message: Reconnect “{{title}}” to the same still-running agent session?

suspend.title: Suspend agent?
suspend.message: Close the agent session for “{{title}}”? The conversation, transcript, workspace, and terminals are retained.

switchAgent.title: Switch agent?
switchAgent.message: Hand “{{title}}” over to a different agent? The conversation's identity, directory and transcript are kept — only the agent behind it changes.

replace.title: Replace agent?
replace.message: Create a new agent session for “{{title}}” while retaining the same conversation and workspace?

delete.title: Delete conversation?
delete.message: This will permanently delete “{{title}}” and its workspace directory, including files inside. Live agent sessions and terminal processes will be stopped first.

blocked.title: Conversation still has live resources
blocked.description: These terminal processes could not be stopped, so the conversation was not deleted: {{resources}}
